name: vision-reader
description: Route image-bearing prompts from text-only Codex models to a dedicated vision subagent without adding an MCP tool to every model.

interface.shortDescription: Route images to a vision subagent only when needed.
interface.longDescription: Detects image-bearing context on text-only models and injects a concise instruction to delegate visual analysis to a dedicated vision_reader subagent.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this image through the vision subagent.
